proves.claim: A change that raises, drops or un-numbers a closure-budget.json row is refused, naming the file, the row, main's number and the new one.

gate.logic-budgets.closure-ceiling-raise.why: Without it, an item could raise its own closure ceiling and carry the headroom up with it, so the cold path creeps with no coordinator decision.

proves.claim: A lowered closure-budget row, an unchanged file and a new row pass the raise check.

gate.logic-budgets.closure-ceiling-lower.why: Without it, main's own downward re-baseline or a new command row would be refused as a raise.

proves.claim: The static registry lists a closure-ceiling class that refuses a raise of the ceilings file against accepted main and skips other changes.

gate.logic-budgets.closure-ceiling-stati.why: Without it, the raise rule exists only as a function that submit, the pre-commit hook and the lander never run.
